description.zh:
资源池名称。
- 长度不超过15个字符。
- 可包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、下划线（_）和点（.）。
description.en:
The name of the resource pool.

- The name can be up to 15 characters long.

- The name can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, underscores (\_), and periods (.).

description.zh:
资源池的优先级。

- 优先级可设置范围：1~99。默认值为1，即最低优先级。
- 提交到具有较高优先级层级值的资源池的作业将在较低优先级层级值的资源池中的挂起作业之前进行调度，资源池的优先级层级优先于作业的优先级。
description.en:
The priority of the resource pool.

- Valid values: 1 to 99. The default value is 1, which specifies the lowest priority.

- Jobs in a higher-priority resource pool are scheduled before pending jobs in lower-priority pools. A resource pool's priority overrides a job's priority.

description.zh: 用户在一个资源池内允许并发使用的资源配额限制。
description.en: The limits on the resources that a user can use concurrently in the resource pool.
The ID of the scheduling policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpcinstant update-pool --pool-name PoolTest --priority 1 --resource-limits MaxExecutorNum=100 --scheduling-policy-id policy-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
